title: subagent: Find FRB papers on arXiv

content:
I need to find two specific papers on arXiv about fast radio bursts (FRBs). Please use webfetch to access the arXiv API and search for these papers:

1. A paper from March 2021 about multiwavelength observations of fast radio bursts that has an X-ray time profile diagram.

2. A paper from July 2020 by one of the same authors about fast radio bursts that has a similar "burst-1" diagram.

The user wants to know the difference in seconds in the measured time span between these two diagrams.

Please:
1. Use webfetch to query the arXiv API at http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=... for papers
2. For the March 2021 paper, search for terms like "multiwavelength", "fast radio burst", "X-ray", "time profile" with date range March 2021
3. For the July 2020 paper, search for papers from July 2020 by similar authors about FRBs
4. Once you find candidate papers, use webfetch to view the full text or abstract pages on arxiv.org to identify the X-ray time profile diagrams
5. Determine the time span (in seconds) shown in each diagram
6. Calculate the difference

Report back with:
- The title and arXiv ID of both papers
- The time span measured in each diagram (in seconds)
- The difference in seconds

Be thorough - try multiple search approaches.
I'll help you find these two papers and compare the time spans in their diagrams. Let me start by searching the arXiv API systematically.
